title: C++: Task Queue with Workers
description: Build a task queue system with multiple workers processing tasks.

steps.title: Task Queue
steps.description: Create a Task struct with function<void()> and id. Create a TaskQueue class with a queue, enqueue(), and dequeue(). Create Worker class that processes tasks from the queue. Simulate 3 workers processing 5 tasks.
hints: Worker: while (hasTasks) { auto task = queue.dequeue(); task(); }
